title: Unbentrock's simple structures
description: This mod adds a couple of structures including a nice starter house and a forest look out tower
body:
⚠️ THIS MOD IS A WORK IN PROGRESS

🏠 Simple Starter House

A lightweight, immersive structure mod fully vanilla friendly.

📜 About the Mod

This mod adds a cozy, pre-built Starter House near your spawn point. It provides a functional head-start without breaking the vanilla progression.

  • 🌿 Starter Farm: A small plot of crops to secure your first meals.
  • 📦 Loot Chest: Contains basic essentials to help you survive the first night.
  • 📍 Natural Spawning: Found within 5 to 20 chunks of world spawn.

🌲 The Scout Update (v1.1.0)

🔭 New Feature: Forest Lookout Tower

  • New Structure: High-altitude wooden towers now generate deep within Forest, Birch Forest, and Taiga biomes.
  • Tower Loot: Reach the top to find scout-themed supplies, including spyglasses and survival gear.

🏰 Improvements & Fixes

  • Perfect Grounding: The starter house now sinks correctly into the terrain. No more floating boxes or gaps under the floorboards!
  • Natural Curves: The hills now blend smoothly to meet your front door, removing the "ugly walls" on hillsides.
  • Waterproofing: Structures will no longer generate in the middle of lakes or rivers.
  • Forest Cleanup: Fixed trees being cut in half; buildings now properly clear out leaves and wood upon spawning.

🕵️ SECRETS...

The starter house holds a dark secret... can you find it?

🔍 How to Find It

These structures generate naturally, but you can locate them instantly with Cheats enabled:

/locate structure testing:starter_house
/locate structure testing:lookout_tower

⚠️ CRITICAL REQUIREMENT

LATEST FABRIC LOADER REQUIRED FOR ALL VERSIONS

Note: Using an outdated Fabric Loader may result in "Incompatible Mod" errors or crashes on startup.

💬 Community & Support

Have a bug report or a suggestion for a new structure? We'd love to hear it!

Join our Discord Community

Mod Version: 1.1.0 | Compatible with latest Fabric
